points: Your site shows 2,000 five-star reviews, yet 0 of 29 ads carry that number. Buyers comparing a tracker to an AirTag need proof before they click. Print 2,000 on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

27 of 29 ads open on “no matter if you’re team Apple or Android,” so new buyers get no second reason to click. Name two or three new angles from your product (keys, bags, passports) and test each against it.

Your site answers how fast orders arrive, yet 0 of 29 ads mention shipping or delivery. A buyer who must leave the ad for that answer may not return. Open three new ads with the delivery answer in line one.

The 20% multi-pack offer appears after 93% of the copy on a median ad of 124 words. Viewers who stop reading early never reach it. Move it into the first two lines of every ad, beside the 15-day trial.
